intro: CAVA Pickled Onions bring a tangy, vibrant burst of flavor to every bowl and pita at CAVA. These quick-pickled red onion slices add brightness and acidity that cuts through rich flavors while adding minimal calories. As part of the [CAVA Toppings Menu](/menu/toppings), Pickled Onions are included at no extra charge, making them an easy way to elevate your Mediterranean meal with bold, zesty flavor.
priceCalories: CAVA Pickled Onions are included with your order at no additional cost, making them a budget-friendly flavor upgrade. At just 20 calories per serving, these tangy onion slices add big taste without impacting your daily calorie goals. With 0g protein, 5g carbs, and 0g fat, Pickled Onions are a light, flavorful addition to explore on the [full CAVA menu](/). Check the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) for personalized meal planning.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets CAVA Pickled Onions apart is their quick-pickling process that preserves the crisp texture of red onions while infusing them with tangy acidity. Unlike raw onions, the pickling mellows their sharpness while adding a bright, vinegary punch. These vibrant purple-pink slices not only enhance flavor but also add visual appeal to your bowl or pita, making every meal more Instagram-worthy and delicious.
nutritionFacts: CAVA Pickled Onions deliver impressive nutritional efficiency at only 20 calories per serving. With 5g of carbohydrates and zero protein or fat, they provide pure flavor without macronutrient density. The minimal calorie count makes them ideal for anyone monitoring intake while still wanting bold taste. Pair them with options from the [CAVA Bases Menu](/menu/bases) and [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains) to build balanced, flavorful meals.
whatsInside: CAVA Pickled Onions feature a simple, clean ingredient list: quick-pickled red onion slices. The quick-pickling process uses vinegar and seasonings to transform fresh red onions into tangy, crisp toppings. With no artificial preservatives or complicated additives, these pickled onions offer pure, straightforward flavor. Their simplicity makes them suitable for various dietary preferences while delivering the authentic Mediterranean taste CAVA is known for.
tasteLike: CAVA Pickled Onions taste bright, tangy, and slightly sweet with a pleasant vinegary punch. The quick-pickling process mellows the raw onion bite while maintaining a satisfying crunch. You will notice notes of acidity that balance rich, creamy dips and savory proteins. The flavor is bold enough to stand out but not overpowering, adding a refreshing contrast that makes every bite more dynamic and interesting.
customize: Customize your CAVA order by adding Pickled Onions to any bowl, pita, or salad for instant flavor enhancement. They pair beautifully with creamy items from the [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads) like hummus or tzatziki. Layer them with Tomato + Onion and Sumac Cabbage Slaw for a vegetable-forward topping combination. Use them to balance rich proteins or add extra tang to grain bowls.
pairsWell: Pickled Onions pair exceptionally well with Shredded Romaine, Pita Crisps, Sumac Cabbage Slaw, and Tomato + Onion from the toppings selection. They complement creamy dressings from the [CAVA Dressings Menu](/menu/dressings) and balance rich proteins. Try them in [CAVA Curated Bowls](/menu/curated-bowls) or [CAVA Curated Pitas](/menu/curated-pitas) for chef-inspired combinations. Their acidity cuts through fatty ingredients, creating perfect flavor harmony in Mediterranean-style meals.
healthyChoice: CAVA Pickled Onions are an excellent healthy choice at just 20 calories with zero fat and protein. They add substantial flavor without compromising nutritional goals, making them ideal for weight management. The vinegar-based pickling process may offer digestive benefits, while red onions provide antioxidants. For dietary restriction guidance, visit the [CAVA Allergen Menu](/allergen-menu) and [CAVA Gluten Free Menu](/gluten-free) to ensure compatibility with your needs.
howToOrder: To order CAVA Pickled Onions, build your custom bowl, pita, or salad and select them from the toppings section at no extra charge. Visit any [CAVA location](/locations) or order online through the CAVA app. Simply indicate you want Pickled Onions added when customizing your meal. They are included automatically in some curated menu items, or you can request them as an addition to any creation.
vsAlternatives: Compared to Tomato + Onion, Pickled Onions offer more tangy acidity and less raw onion bite at the same 20-calorie count. Unlike Sumac Cabbage Slaw which has 30 calories, Pickled Onions provide sharper vinegar notes rather than citrusy brightness. While Shredded Romaine offers crunch at only 5 calories, Pickled Onions deliver concentrated flavor. Pita Crisps at 70 calories provide texture but lack the acidic punch that makes Pickled Onions unique.
whoShouldTry: CAVA Pickled Onions are perfect for anyone who loves bold, tangy flavors and wants to enhance their Mediterranean meal without added calories or cost. Ideal for health-conscious diners watching fat intake while craving big taste. Pickle lovers and those who appreciate acidic, bright flavors will especially enjoy them. If you typically add raw onions but want a mellower, more complex flavor, Pickled Onions are your perfect upgrade.
worthTrying: CAVA Pickled Onions are absolutely worth trying for their exceptional flavor-to-calorie ratio and zero additional cost. They transform ordinary bowls into restaurant-quality meals with minimal nutritional impact. The quick-pickled preparation offers superior taste to raw onions while adding visual appeal. Since they are included free, there is no reason not to experiment with these tangy, vibrant toppings that exemplify CAVA's commitment to fresh, flavorful Mediterranean cuisine.
